registration.signature: PQCHybridSignature (secp256k1 + ML-DSA-87), events pqc_hybrid_verify and pqc_kem_key_registered

steps: read the account's ML-KEM-1024 key from the on-chain registry (fetchKemKey)
confirmed it equals the locally generated public key
sealToAddresses to that address (mode mlkem, purpose future-post-welcome) -> 1 recipient entry, 1737-byte envelope
open with the matching secret key -> plaintext matches
open with a fresh outsider key -> refused (NOT_A_RECIPIENT)
open under a different purpose -> refused (DECRYPTION_FAILED)

scope: A published ML-KEM-1024 key for this single-purpose testnet account, and a local seal-to-address and open round trip against the on-chain key. The browser app in this repository does not read the registry; its proof screen uses fresh in-browser keys.
secret_material: The matching secret key is held privately and is not part of this repository.
